THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I , Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An allotment of land depicted in below name and extent in the Advance Tracing No. MN/MNN/2023/488 dated 25.10.2023 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the Village called Thullukudiyiruppu in the Grama Niladhari Division No. MN/54 of Mannar Town of Thullukudiyiruppu in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Mannar District in Nothern Province and bounded as follows:
01. Lot A – Thullukudiyiruppukaani – Extent: 2.8900 Hectares North, East, South and West: Thullukudiyiruppukaani (claimant not known). Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My Ref. No. : 4-3/11/2023/RE/140.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,"Mihikatha Medura", Rajamalwaththa Avenue,Battaramulla.1st February, 2024.
